newsitem.title: GERMANY: Duesseldorf air cargo drops 2.6 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Duesseldorf air cargo drops 2.6 pct in 1996.

text.p: Air cargo handled at Duesseldorf Airport fell 2.6 percent to 109,034 tonnes in 1996, airport authority Flughafen Duesseldorf GmbH said.
Flown air cargo rose 1.6 percent to 58,683 tonnes after picking up 9.7 percent July-December from a 7.1 percent decline in the first half-year.
Export flown cargo rose 10.3 percent to 27,988 tonnes last year but import cargo declined 4.6 percent to 29,245 tonnes, a market research department report showed.
The official estimate of trucked cargo showed a decline of seven percent to 50,351 tonnes last year. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax +5017
